item.title: Plainfield Township (MI) FD Welcomes New Engine
item.description: The new Engine 3 has a 1,750-gallon-per-minute (gpm) pump and a 500-gallon water tank. It's also equipped to respond to vehicle crashes, medical emergencies, and smaller-scale hazardous materials incidents. item.title: CA Fire Apparatus Crashes En Route to Separate Collision
item.description: A Sonoma County fire engine crashed while responding to another collision in Windsor. Two people in a Prius were hospitalized; no firefighters were injured. The incident is under investigation. item.title: City Apparatus Taken from Yantic (CT) Engine Company Back in Service
item.description: Norwich's Yantic Fire Engine Co. No. 1 was shut down for non-compliance with a new unified command policy, leading to repossession of firetrucks.
